name: Mama to Saimin Gokko
source:
Playing along with her son, a mother pretends to fall under his hypnosis...

The son, thinking his beloved mama is completely unconscious, starts to do the most unimaginable things!
In the end, even the son's friends become involved, and the brutal party begins to really heat up...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033290.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
